newsitem.title: UK: C&W off on worries of digital competition.
newsitem.headline: C&W off on worries of digital competition.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless fell on Friday over worries about competition from other consortia for the supply of digital television services, traders said.
Shares in C&W were down 9p at 470p by 1240 GMT.
"It's just taken the edge off them," one trader said.

A cable television consortium which includes C&W's Mercury subsidiary, NYNEX CableComms, Bell Cablemedia and Videotron are set to upgrade their own cable system to provide digital television services.
But traders were concerned the new group would face competition from a new consortium led by BSkyB.
The UK satellite broadcaster on Friday teamed up with Carlton Communications and Granada Group to run digital terrestrial television services .
